title: Paid but cannot access app without paying again
body: Paid separately on Instagram advert but when installed app cannot login without having to pay full payment again. Terrible interface and support cannot help. Do not pay outside IOS or Playstore if you want to try.
author: YC - 2021

title: Bad
body: Keep asking to make payment. No 1 time payment for life. Regret purchasing .. Paid $29.
author: mlbbcch

title: Kept asking for payment without trying out the app
body:
Not know the app yet kept getting prompt to make payment. 
It’s like asking people to try a black box and ask them pay for it, when people don’t even know what it is about.
